title: Think Before You Swing
story: In the Hall of Ten Thousand Reflections stood Splinterjack, a golem of polished glass that split into two identical golems every single time it was struck. A young squire had already swung once and was now surrounded. Mr 6 lowered his sword and started counting instead.
question: If Mr 6 had struck the single golem 7 times in a row, with the number of golems doubling after each strike, how many golems would be standing?
hint: One strike makes 2, two strikes make 4 — keep doubling and count exactly seven doublings.
victory: Mr 6 sheathed his sword, held up a mirror, and let Splinterjack strike its own reflection — the doubling curse cancelled itself and the hall went quiet. 'One hundred twenty-eight reasons,' he told the squire, 'to think first.'
imagePrompt: A hall of tall silver mirrors reflecting a crystalline golem endlessly, with a small numeral-six knight calmly sheathing his sword and raising a hand mirror in the cool blue light.
